correctness.rationale: For fixed 0<lambda<1, a Bloch rotation composed with dephasing is explicitly block diagonal. Cayley--Hamilton gives r_n and v_n exactly; since det(A^n)=lambda^n>0, the two-by-two singular value sum squared is trace(A^n)^2+(A^n_12-A^n_21)^2. Adding lambda^n and applying Lami--Giovannetti Eq. (7) proves the all-n EB equivalence. Schur stability proves eventual breaking away from θ=0,π. Near θ=0 the slow root is 1-a_lambda θ²+O(θ⁴), the fast root is lambda(1+a_lambda θ²+O(θ⁴)); uniform n~log(1/θ) estimates imply the scaled defect profile and O(1)-sharp index asymptotic. value.rationale: The direct breaking index is a natural operational invariant because it counts how many identical noisy channel uses destroy all entanglement with an arbitrary ancilla. Pure aligned phase damping never becomes EB at finite n, but arbitrarily small transverse rotation makes it eventually EB. The exact all-n criterion, logarithm with a negative loglog correction, and a sharp rescaled crossover quantify a genuine singular physical boundary rather than a routine isolated numeric calculation. The result deliberately excludes optimized filtering and other noise families.
